lastCompletedStory.title: Encode the no-flaky-evasion hard-stop rule in subagent-reviewer.md

openQuestions: Non-blocking observability note: one full 'bun test' run out of ~20 consecutive runs (spread across plain 'bun test' and full 'bun run check:all' invocations, including 4 runs under deliberate artificial CPU-stress via background 'yes' processes) reported '3403 pass / 1 fail' instead of the steady-state '3404 pass / 0 fail'. The failing test name could not be captured (the anomalous run's full log was not retained before rediscovery) and it did not reproduce again despite repeated attempts including under stress. This is consistent with the already-documented dashboard.test.ts keypress-timing flake class (see patterns.md 'Dogfooding the no-flaky-evasion rule...' and 'Gotcha encountered on THIS story...' entries from US-002/CAM-202), which was already given a poll-based fix (waitForAccentLine) in the prior story. Every gate run used for THIS story's own DONE decision (the one recorded in worker-report.json) was independently verified green (0 fail) per the no-flaky-evasion rule this very story encodes; no red gate was narrated green. Flagging here per the rule's own instruction to document any flaky/failing test observed, even when not reproducible or attributable to this story's diff (pure prose edits to two agent markdown files, zero test/source changes).
nextStoryContext: US-003 is done: both templates/agents/subagent-reviewer.md and .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md now carry a '### No-flaky-evasion hard stop' subsection (placed between '### Green tests do not prove correctness' and '### Hard-constraint rule', inside the 'Layer B Verdict: Binary PASS/FAIL Rubric' section) plus a new bullet appended to the existing '### Hard-constraint rule' list, mirroring the wording/mechanism-naming style of US-002's implementer-side rule (same four required substrings: flaky, pre-existing, environmental, unrelated; same named-mechanism tie-in to gateTestsIndicateFailure in src/supervisor/result.ts). The two copies' PRE-EXISTING intentional deltas (the .claude/agents copy's CLI-context security checklist, concrete gate commands, and the runBehavioralGate invocation detail in its Layer B Behavioral Gate section) were left untouched; only the shared/common sections were edited identically in both files, per the story's own gotcha note. Ran embed-vendor + embed-vendor:check (clean), typecheck (clean), bun test (clean on the recorded run), and full bun run check:all (clean, exit 0) before commit. If a future story needs to touch the implementer/reviewer no-flaky-evasion wording again (e.g. a hypothetical US-004 tightening enforcement further), the two anchor subsections to edit are now: subagent-implementer.md's '### No-flaky-evasion hard stop' (under '## Gate discipline') and subagent-reviewer.md's new '### No-flaky-evasion hard stop' (under 'Layer B Verdict') in BOTH template and runtime copies, then embed-vendor + embed-vendor:check. No other non-operator stories were inspected during this story; check prd.json fresh for the next highest-priority passes:false story.
